source.publisher: University of California, as published in the Chabot College 2025-2026 Catalog
source.document_title: Chabot College 2025-2026 Catalog - University of California (UC) transfer admission requirements; Advanced Placement chart
source.requirement_text: Complete the following seven-course pattern, earning a grade of C or better in each course: Two transferable college courses (3 semester or 4-5 quarter units) in English composition; One transferable college course (3 semester or 4-5 quarter units) in mathematical concepts and quantitative reasoning; Four transferable college courses (3 semester or 4-5 quarter units each) chosen from at least two of the following subject areas: arts and humanities, social and behavioral sciences, and physical and biological sciences.
source.note: Transcribed because the dedicated UC 7-Course Pattern JSON was not provided. Replace this file with that JSON (or keep both and delete this one) when it is available.

scope.note: A UC admission requirement for junior-level transfer, not a GE certification pattern and not a CSU requirement. Courses must be UC-transferable; ASSIST marks the eligible courses of each college with UC transfer admission areas UC-E, UC-M, UC-H, UC-B and UC-S.

ge_pathway.name: UC 7-Course Pattern
ge_pathway.multiple_area_use_note: Seven courses: each course counts once.

requirements.name: English composition
requirements.rule: Two transferable college courses (3 semester or 4-5 quarter units) in English composition.

requirements.name: Mathematical concepts and quantitative reasoning
requirements.rule: One transferable college course (3 semester or 4-5 quarter units) in mathematical concepts and quantitative reasoning.

requirements.name: Breadth: at least two of arts & humanities, social & behavioral sciences, physical & biological sciences
requirements.rule: Four transferable college courses (3 semester or 4-5 quarter units each) chosen from at least two of the following subject areas: arts and humanities, social and behavioral sciences, and physical and biological sciences.

ap_rules.source: Chabot College 2025-2026 Catalog, Advanced Placement chart (pp. 41-43), column 'UC Max Units/Subject Requirement Areas'. Exams with no UC area in that column are not listed.
ap_rules.note: Each qualifying exam counts as one course in one of its areas.

exams.note: No credit for the Music Theory subscore.

general_rules.minimum_grade: C or better in each course
general_rules.other_admission_requirements: 60 semester (90 quarter) UC-transferable units with a GPA of at least 2.4 (2.8 for nonresidents); at most 14 semester units Pass/Not Pass. Not planned here.

notes: The UC 7-course pattern is a UC transfer admission requirement. It does not apply to CSU campuses.
It is not IGETC and not Cal-GETC; campus GE (for example Berkeley L&S Seven-Course Breadth) is a different requirement.
